title.zh: 马斯克称Colossus 2年底将部署120万块Blackwell，20万块专门跑推理
title.en: 马斯克称Colossus 2年底将部署120万块Blackwell，20万块专门跑推理

current_state.zh:
马斯克披露，xAI位于孟菲斯的超级计算集群 Colossus 2 计划在年底前部署约 120 万块英伟达 Blackwell GPU。接下来还有两座设施投运：Gun Range 预计 11 月底上线 22 万块 GB300，用于模型训练；Spam 由一座原本存放午餐肉等食品的仓库改造而来，计划部署约 20 万块 GB300，专门用于 AI 推理。

马斯克称，目前 Macrohard 配有 11 万块 GB200 和 22 万块 GB300，Macroharder、Minihard 各有 22 万块 GB300；加上计划新增的 42 万块，五个集群合计约 119 万块。他表示，Macroharder、Minihard 和 Gun Range 均采用 800Gbps 网卡，而 Spam 的推理任务网络配置更简单，所需光纤不到训练设施的一半。
current_state.en: Musk said xAI's Colossus 2 will deploy about 1.2 million Nvidia Blackwell GPUs by year-end, including roughly 200,000 GB300s dedicated to inference at a converted food warehouse.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Musk said xAI's Colossus 2 will deploy about 1.2 million Nvidia Blackwell GPUs by year-end, including roughly 200,000 GB300s dedicated to inference at a converted food warehouse.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Musk said xAI's Colossus 2 will deploy about 1.2 million Nvidia Blackwell GPUs by year-end, including roughly 200,000 GB300s dedicated to inference at a converted food warehouse.
updates.background_zh: Blackwell 是英伟达接替 Hopper 的 GPU 架构；GB300 NVL72 是液冷的机架级系统，集成 72 块 Blackwell Ultra GPU 和 36 颗基于 Arm 的 Grace CPU，定位面向测试时扩展的推理与 AI 推理任务。训练与推理对 GPU 基础设施的要求不同，推理通常更看重时延、吞吐和单位 token 成本，而非最大规模的高速互联。
updates.background_en: Blackwell is Nvidia's GPU architecture succeeding Hopper; the GB300 NVL72 is a rack-scale, liquid-cooled system that integrates 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs with 36 Arm-based Grace CPUs and is marketed for test-time scaling inference and AI reasoning workloads. Training and inference place different demands on GPU infrastructure, with inference generally prioritizing latency, throughput and cost per token over the largest-scale high-speed interconnect.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若上述数字兑现，将成为英伟达 GB300 机架级系统以及配套电力、散热与网络供应链的需求信号。对加密市场而言，传导路径主要是与 AI 算力相关的代币及 GPU 邻近基础设施叙事的情绪面，而非直接敞口；且这些数字仍属公司目标，而非已核实的部署。
updates.market_impact_en: The numbers, if delivered, are a demand signal for Nvidia's GB300 rack-scale systems and the surrounding power, cooling and networking supply chain. For crypto markets the transmission runs through sentiment toward AI-compute-linked tokens and GPU-adjacent infrastructure narratives rather than any direct exposure, and the figures remain a company target rather than a verified deployment.
